items.detail: Visa is in hand. You board the Z165 and enter Disneyland on this — both are passport-scanned, real-name systems.
Couriered to the Westin Xi'an. No permit, no boarding for Lhasa. Confirm it has physically arrived on 1 Oct and photograph it.
Permit, passport, insurance, hotel confirmations and the Drive 'Important Info In China' sheet — Drive is blocked without offshore data. Use the Dossier export on this page.

Buy it in Xi'an, Y100–200. A US-market unit has no moulded 3C mark and is confiscated at Lhasa on the mainland domestic flight; lithium can't go in the hold either. Needed for thirty hours on a Z-service with no reliable power.
Neither is obtainable inside China. Last day is 27 Sep.

items.item: Offline map packs and translate pack
items.detail: Organic Maps for Shaanxi, Shanghai and Tibet; the Google Translate offline Chinese pack for camera translation; Pleco for the dictionary.
China runs 220V; sockets take both flat A and angled I pins.

For everything in Xi'an including brushing your teeth, and no ice. Sandra was rigorous about exactly that until she trusted a hostel water cooler in this city, and it cost her the better part of five days. In 2026 the same five days would cost you the permit handoff, the Z165 and the tour.
Talk to a doctor. You go from Xi'an at 400 m to sleeping at 5,200 m in five days, with 5,248 m at Gyatso La. Day 1 in Lhasa is deliberately empty for a reason.

items.item: High-SPF sunscreen, lip balm, dark sunglasses
items.detail: UV on the plateau is brutal even when the air is cold.

items.item: Down jacket and thermal base layers
items.detail: A tent at 5,200 m in October. Two sets of base layers — one to wear, one dry.

Earplugs, eye mask, bottled water, cup noodles, and something to eat that isn't cup noodles. Soft sleeper is four bunks behind a door that closes — expect other passengers to treat your lower berth as the room's sofa during the day.
Every Chinese train car has a boiling-water dispenser. This is how you eat well on a thirty-hour ride.

items.item: The full list lives on the Packing List page
items.detail: This section holds only the train-and-altitude essentials the master itinerary calls out. Four bags across four climates, with tick state, is on the Packing List page in the Trip Kit; the shopping side is on the Prep Checklist page.
